description: Protocol Envelope for Widget Controllers (Hands). Maps ui_actions to the data sidecar.

descriptor.sidecar_instruction: an array of widget actions, each {"target_widget": "goals_widget" | "sentiment_meter" | "...", "action": "update" | "set" | "...", "payload": { ...object matching the specific widget schema... }}; you may act without speaking, and you return [] only when no widget should change.
